 5:45 PM ET 2 hours ago Chase Center
 The Chase Center is the basketball and entertainment arena in San Francisco, California, and the home of the NBA's Golden State Warriors. It's located in Mission Bay, by the bay, at 1 Warriors Way, right at the intersection of Third and 16th Streets. From the outside, it stands out for its rounded shape, white facade, and large windows. Behind it rise modern office towers and laboratories. The arena is part of a larger complex, which also includes offices, shops, restaurants, and a plaza.
 To understand its history, it's helpful to go back to the Warriors' origins. The team was founded in Philadelphia in 1946 and arrived in the San Francisco Bay Area.ay Area in 1962. From 1971, they played in the Oakland arena, known for many years as Oracle Arena. They only left that venue for a brief period: during the 1996-97 season, they moved to San Jose while renovations were underway. Oracle, with a capacity of nearly 19,600, was the oldest arena in the NBA. Over the years, it became outdated, and management began considering a return to San Francisco. The move was announced in 2012, and construction began on January 17, 2017.
 In terms of capacity, the Chase Center can accommodate 18,064 people for basketball games, slightly less than Oracle, and around 19,500 for concerts. It also features 44 suites on the upper level, 32 courtside lounges and 60 theater-style boxes, as well as several spaces for eating and drinking.
